summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Material Request new features (manual entry, custom size, inline inputs). Backend: 13/13 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements present and functional.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed material orders during testing (automatically visible in Mijn Bestellingen)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Material Request features fully implemented. All 3 new features working: 1) Manual entry section ('Niet in catalogus?') with description, qty, m², lm inputs and photo upload. 2) Custom size option 'Anders...' in size dropdown that shows text input field for non-standard sizes. 3) Inline quantity (+/-), m², lm inputs directly on catalog cards. Backend endpoints: POST /api/material-orders (with is_manual and lm fields), POST /api/material-orders/upload-photo (for manual item photos). Manual items show '[Handmatig]' prefix in order titles.

Worker Login.details: POST /api/auth/worker/login works with testwerkman/Werk123456, returns session_token

Material Catalog.details: GET /api/material-catalog returns catalog items with sizes array

Custom Size 'Anders...' Option.details: Size dropdown includes '__custom__' value that shows text input field (data-testid='custom-size-input-{id}')

Manual Entry Section.details: Section visible with data-testid='manual-entry-section', includes description input, qty +/- buttons, m² input, lm input, photo button, add button

Manual Entry Photo Upload.details: POST /api/material-orders/upload-photo accepts image files, returns image_url starting with /api/static/catalog/

Material Order with Manual Item.details: POST /api/material-orders accepts is_manual=true items, creates MaterialRequest with '[Handmatig]' prefix in title

Material Order with lm Field.details: lm (lopende meter) field is stored and displayed in order title (e.g., '- 8.5lm')

Cart Display Handmatig Badge.details: Manual items show 'Handmatig' badge in cart (amber colored badge)

Cart lm Inputs.details: Cart items have data-testid='cart-lm-{idx}' input for lopende meter

Order Submission.details: Full order flow works: catalog items + manual items submitted, success toast shown, redirected to Mijn Bestellingen

screenshots_taken: Order submitted - Mijn Bestellingen showing all orders
